Strong was tricked into guard duty by a disciple of the Nine Mortal Ways.
Lured by the scent of meat, Strong followed the man draped in black cloth with a gourd tied to his waist, staring longingly at the meat chunks in his hand.
But once inside the courtyard gate, the man shut the door and spread his hands empty. Where was the meat? Just a straw dummy.
Amid roaring laughter, Strong whimpered in dismay.
Damn it, the Nine Mortal Ways—even dogs aren’t spared.
Only after laughing his fill did the man finally take out real meat under Strong’s pitiful gaze. Feeding him, he said, "Alright, alright, just a harmless prank. Here, have some meat. Look at you, skin and bones—why not stick with us Nine Mortal Ways? We’ll keep you well-fed. Just don’t ask where the food comes from, deal?"
